crossRefs.note: Then they said to one another, “We aren’t doing right. Today is a day of good news, and we keep silent. If we wait…
He didn’t allow him, but said to him, “Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has…
Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast…
She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him, and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas”…
So the woman left her water pot, went away into the city, and said to the people,
“Come, see a man who told me everything that I did. Can this be the Christ?”
For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;
but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Someone went in, and told his lord, saying, “The maiden who is from the land of Israel said this.”
translations.bsb: And Naaman went and told his master what the girl from the land of Israel had said.
translations.kjv: And one went in, and told his lord, saying, Thus and thus said the maid that is of the land of Israel.
translations.asv: And one went in, and told his lord, saying, Thus and thus said the maiden that is of the land of Israel.
